scope: Independent external research on agent architecture, GitHub result handoff, instruction composition/versioning, critical agent methods, multiple Smart Subagents, natural chat style, selective knowledge loading, and evaluation.

input_package.name: novastory-agent-files-audit
input_package.handling: The supplied task text was used as the authoritative description of intent. No package-specific facts were inferred.

main_recommendations.github_handoff_v1: isolated run branch and task folder, authenticated push webhook, exact candidate commit SHA, shared validator, polling fallback, idempotent processing
main_recommendations.instructions: base role instruction first, owner instruction second, immutable versions, explicit diff/activation, permissions enforced outside prompt text
main_recommendations.critical_agent: task contract, selective delegation, structured integration, risk-proportional verification, evidence-based completion
main_recommendations.multiple_subagents: default one; parallel 2-3 only when independence, breadth, critique or verification creates measurable value
main_recommendations.natural_chat: answer first, then cause and consequence, explain precise terms, no automatic agreement or flattery, proportional structure
main_recommendations.knowledge_v1: root/domain/capability indexes plus source metadata and exact/keyword section retrieval; add semantic/hybrid/reranking/graph only after measured failures

open_owner_decisions: direct commit vs PR promotion policy
source_policy: Official documentation and primary/open-source/scientific sources were prioritized. Each source is documented in SOURCES.md with verification date and supported claim.
delivery_note: The final Git commit SHA is intentionally not embedded in this file because a commit cannot self-contain its own hash without changing that hash. The delivery response and remote repository commit identify the exact result revision.
